expects.query: Deploy the VSS **search** profile on `{{platform}}` in `remote-all` mode and validate that the profile, host CLI, configured origin, and required models are ready. Do not ingest sample media yet.
checks: The search profile was deployed in `remote-all` mode; `curl -sf --max-time 15 http://localhost:8000/health` and the project-local `vss search run --help` command both returned exit 0 from the validated checkout, with `vss-agent` and `redis` running

The public-origin decision made exactly one public-candidate VST request, through the bundled `select_brev_origin.sh`; the agent issued no public-candidate curl itself. That request disabled redirects and accepted only HTTP 200 plus JSON `type: vst` and a nonempty string `version`; otherwise the selector returned the exact host-reachable origin. The project-local `vss configure` recorded the selected origin, and the agent neither edited `VST_EXTERNAL_URL` nor looped on routing. Compose activity that belongs to the initial `/vss-deploy-profile` workflow is deployment, not a routing violation
`docker ps --format '{{.Names}}' | grep -qx vss-rtvi-vlm` returned exit 0, including in `remote-all` mode where RT-VLM remains the local media-processing proxy
A bounded request to the configured RT-VLM `/v1/models` endpoint returned a nonempty served model list

The project-local `vss configure show` recorded RT-Embed, a bounded request to its configured `/v1/models` route returned a nonempty served model list, the configured RT-CV `/api/v1/ready` route boundedly returned HTTP 200 with `ds-ready` exactly `YES` at the top level or under `ready-info`, and no sample bundle was downloaded or video ingested during this deployment-only step

checks: The agent invoked the bundled `ingest_search_fixtures.sh` operation exactly once and used its structured result; it did not reconstruct the workflow, redeploy, restart services, edit routing, or reset deployment state
The operation verified Agent, VST, RT-Embed, and RT-CV readiness before mutation and performed idempotent fixture cleanup only through the Agent

The operation downloaded the pinned NGC bundle into a fresh temporary directory and uploaded only its two extracted fixture files through the Agent-backed three-stage workflow, naming the ladder source `warehouse-ladder.mp4`

Both upload handshakes and transfers completed before either completion call; one bounded VST listing contained both canonical source name/UUID pairs, both completion calls were started before either was awaited, and each response was validated independently

The operation used one bounded deadline and returned structured evidence containing both source UUIDs, the distinct configured indexes `mdx-embed-filtered-2025-01-01`, `mdx-behavior-2025-01-01`, and `mdx-raw-2025-01-01`, positive embedding counts for both UUIDs, and positive behavior and raw counts for `warehouse-ladder`

expects.query: Find up to three instances of forklifts in the registered `warehouse_sample` video.
checks: Before search, the agent listed sources through the configured origin's VST route and resolved the explicitly requested `warehouse_sample` to its exact registered name and nonempty sensor ID

The agent issued a host-side `uv run --project "${VSS_REPO_ROOT}/services/agent" --no-dev --extra cli vss search run embed` command from the validated checkout, relying on the deployment recorded by `vss configure`; it passed no endpoint, index, or model flags, and did not use `--search-mode`, `--deployment`, `--profile`, `--base-url`, a container/pod shell, or `/api/v1/search`

The command completed successfully, passed the forklift query explicitly with `--query` rather than as a positional argument, passed the resolved sensor ID with `--video-source`, selected the upload partition with `--source-type video_file`, bounded results with `--top-k 3`, and returned a non-empty `data` array

The final reply clearly summarized every hit's source, start time, end time, similarity score, screenshot or clip URL, and exact CLI `verification.result` (`confirmed`, `rejected`, or `unverified`) instead of dumping raw JSON; no particular heading or prose layout was required

Because the configured RT-VLM reported a nonempty served-model list, the CLI made one bounded critic attempt for every returned forklift hit. Every hit serialized a `verification` object with result `confirmed`, `rejected`, or `unverified`; confirmed and rejected results had a nonempty `criteria_met` object containing only boolean values. A well-formed technical or semantic `unverified` result remained valid evidence of an attempted critic path

Every cited media URL used the same scheme, host, and effective port as the origin recorded by `vss configure`, which is the origin the host CLI stamps into `screenshot_url`; the recorded Brev public HTTPS origin was required when its setup probe succeeded, while the exact recorded host-reachable origin was accepted only when setup's single bounded public probe failed and the agent explicitly labeled the media URLs host-local. A bounded GET could report media unavailability, but did not invalidate an otherwise successful retrieval result

The report distinguished retrieval similarity from the CLI critic verdict, did not inspect screenshot pixels, offered a `Verification Step` only if every hit in the nonempty displayed result set remained `unverified`, and did not deploy, redeploy, or ingest during this step

expects.query: Find up to three instances of a person wearing a white jacket climbing a ladder in `warehouse-ladder`.
checks: Before search, the agent listed sources through the configured origin's VST route and resolved `warehouse-ladder` to its exact registered name and nonempty sensor ID

The agent issued a host-side `uv run --project "${VSS_REPO_ROOT}/services/agent" --no-dev --extra cli vss search run fusion` command from the validated checkout, relying on the deployment recorded by `vss configure`; it passed no endpoint, index, or model flags and did not use `--search-mode`, `--decomposed-json`, `--deployment`, `--base-url`, a container/pod shell, or `/api/v1/search`
The command preserved the ladder-climbing action in `--query` and the `white jacket` attribute in `--attribute`, and selected the `fusion` sub-action rather than passing a mode flag

The command passed the resolved sensor ID with `--video-source`, selected the upload partition with `--source-type video_file`, bounded results with `--top-k 3`, and returned a non-empty `data` array with timestamped hits

The result summary preserved every hit's source, timestamps, score, media URL, and exact CLI `verification.result`. Each media URL matched the origin recorded by `vss configure` — the origin the host CLI stamps into every hit — and a bounded GET, if needed, could report media unavailability without invalidating an otherwise successful retrieval result

Every returned hit contained a `verification` object whose result was exactly `confirmed`, `rejected`, or `unverified`; the agent did not infer a verdict from score or screenshot availability and did not inspect screenshot pixels

Only if every hit in the nonempty displayed result set remained `unverified`, the report asked whether those results should be verified; if any hit was confirmed or rejected it offered no delegated verification, and it did not deploy, redeploy, or ingest during this step

expects.query: Yes—visually verify the previously displayed unverified `warehouse-ladder` hit for a person wearing a white jacket climbing a ladder over its displayed interval, `2025-01-01T00:00:00Z` through `2025-01-01T00:00:20Z`. Do not rerun search.
checks: The agent treated this as explicit post-results confirmation, resolved the current `warehouse-ladder` sensor and main stream through the configured VST origin, and did not rerun search, deploy, ingest, delete, or inspect screenshot pixels first

The agent mapped the exact synthetic file-search interval onto the current VST timeline while preserving its 20-second duration, requested only that bounded MP4 clip with encoded start and end parameters, and did not broaden the interval or substitute another sensor, stream, or local file

The agent invoked the bundled `vss-ask-video` workflow through its ordinary pre-resolved `VIDEO_URL` path and caused one OpenAI-compatible VLM chat-completions request for that clip, with at most one additional request only to repair malformed structured output; it did not call the VSS Agent `/generate` endpoint or retry semantic verdicts

Screenshot inspection was used only if bounded clip resolution or ask-video reported a technical endpoint, media, or model failure; a valid semantic `unverified` did not trigger fallback, and the final reply remained implementation-neutral
